_set_comment: THE golden set for the 'Kangaroo' sheet: its 6 rows are the vet-clinic products (NexGard/Heartgard/Virbac) printed in the Kangaroo half of KPN_Kangaroo-updated.pdf ('Price List (Vet Clinics only)'), which the vet-clinic layout contract reads. The ZIWI set (kangaroo_pn_unit) keeps its PDF-derived sheet as calibration only.
_covered_comment: V42 (Virbac Allerderm) is named on the sheet but absent from the updated catalogue (searched the full capture) — a question about the sheet, kept in expected.csv verbatim (alfamedic precedent).

known_gaps.supplier: the sheet writes 'Kangaroo'; the export carries the contract supplier 'Kangaroo Pet Nutrition'
known_gaps.brand: no brand column exists — the brand prefix (NexGard SPECTRA, Heartgard PLUS) is embedded in the description text; the contract deliberately leaves brand unmapped, so the export says 'Unbranded'
known_gaps.package_configuration: sheet holds '3 TABS/PACK' etc.; the export falls back to the variant UOM 'unit' (same shape as the kpn/hills gap) — the "1x3's" packing notation is not parsed into a configuration today
known_gaps.sellable_uom: sheet says PACK; the review-desk draft falls back to 'unit' when packaging resolves no sellable UOM
known_gaps.sellable_units_per_price_basis: sheet derives 3 (tablets per pack) from the packing notation; the pipeline does not parse "1x3's" into a unit count today
known_gaps.weight: sheet filled (40g/45g) but the value never reaches the published export (same as the other sets)
known_gaps.mbb_tier_1: the sheet records the free-goods terms ('10+2', '10+1'); the export publishes no term — clinic-offer text routes to review verbatim (KANGAROO_PN_VET_CLINIC_FREE_GOODS_NOT_STRUCTURED)
known_gaps.mbb_tier_2: second free-goods tier ('10+3 (50 or more per order)', '20+3') — same gap as mbb_tier_1

not_comparable.product_name: the sheet holds human shorthand ('Nexgard Spectra M 7.5-15kg'); the export holds the supplier's printed description with the brand line prefix
not_comparable.product name [Rosetta]: a hand-authored retail name, not something the pipeline derives
not_comparable.order_multiple: the sheet derives it from pack contents ('3 TABLETS'); not printed as such on this layout and not published
not_comparable.rrp: this layout prints no retail column; the sheet writes the literal 'N/A'
not_comparable.mbb_tier_3: sheet holds 'N/A' for all covered rows
not_comparable.mbb_tier_4: sheet holds 'N/A' for all covered rows

_contract_comment: The legacy kangaroo.mixed_price_catalogue.v1 cannot read this layout (its required headers 產品名稱/建議零售價 are not printed here — verified by a zero-row conformance run), so the layout-split doctrine applied: this set exercises the purpose-authored vet-clinic contract. Supplier 81 has many contracts, so explicit contract_id is mandatory.
_pages_comment: Vet-clinic price list carved from the whole-catalogue capture of KPN_Kangaroo-updated.pdf (2026-08-13 chat-agent capture). Identity OMITTED: the merged capture recorded only KPN's supplier_identity_text; the Kangaroo section prints its own ('港澳總代理 袋鼠寵物營養有限公司 Kangaroo Pet Nutrition Ltd.') which a per-page recapture would restore.
_graduated_comment: Graduated from golden_staging/ on 2026-08-13 after the contract's promotion to SUPPORTED. The golden framework resolves supplier-only, which works because this supplier has exactly ONE SUPPORTED contract; contract_id is kept for the day a second layout is promoted (the runtime will then demand explicit selection).
